component-metadata.description:
Changes values in a selected column. Replacements need to be inserted as a table with one column containing the original names and another table containing their desired replacements.
The "Lookup string modifiers" form field enables further specification of string replacement. If "full word" is selected, only full words (i.e. strings surrounded by whitespace) which match the lookup string will be replaced. If "regex" is selected, the lookup string will be interpreted and processed as a regular expression.
NOTE: Selected column will be always returned at original position in the table but column type will be converted to string.
